thread:
Mira (Sales): Heads up — Rapidsample just confirmed they want a formal throughput proof for procurement. Target: sustain 1k QPS for 20m, p50 <120ms, p99 <450ms. They asked for FIPS-compatible KMS and a costable quote. Can eng craft a run plan + cost-band?

Jamal (Solutions Eng): Noted. Two quick clarifying q's: 1) Are responses streamed (chunked) or single-shot completions? 2) Do they require model pinning to a quantized variant? Streaming adds head-of-line tail issues.

Mira (Sales): It's mixed: 60% short single-shot completions (~60 tokens out), 40% streaming assistant-turns (avg context 800 tokens) with occasional tool calls. They insist on FIPS 140-2 KMS and want to know if Dedicated is sufficient or if they need Private for guaranteed egress controls.

Noor (Perf Eng): Streaming with tool calls complicates batching. For 1k QPS with 40% streaming, we should plan on a hybrid fleet: some workers optimized for streaming (small batches, concurrency=6) and some for short completions (batch=12, concurrency=20). Recommend warm pool of 16 GPUs (A100-80G equiv) to start — adjust after small ramp.

Noor (Perf Eng): Important: KV cache locality matters for multi-turn. If churn rate is high we lose KV benefits and p99 goes up. We'll configure KV TTL to 15m for the test and seed the cache in the smoke phase.

Jamal (Solutions Eng): Proposed run outline:
- Prep: collect KMS endpoint + peering topology, confirm model binary (fp16/q4)
- Smoke: 10m @ 200 QPS to warm cache and prefetch keys
- Main: Poisson ramp 0->1k QPS over 6m, hold 20m, spike tests (2x bursts for 30s)
- Soak: optional 1h at 600 QPS for stability

Noor (Perf Eng): Quick CLI example for their load harness (different from earlier):

```bash
# using k6-style script runner
k6 run --vus 250 --duration 00:23:20 --rps 1000 --config profile_rapidsample.js \
  --env API_URL=https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat --env TOKEN=$TOKEN
```

Jamal (Solutions Eng): profile_rapidsample.js will implement the 60/40 mix and simulate streaming chunked responses with random inter-chunk delays to surface head-of-line issues. We'll also include intermittent tool-call emulation to test downstream latencies.

Olga (Security): For FIPS KMS: we need their HSM vendor, endpoint, cert chain, and expected QPS on KMS (key unwraps/sec). If KMS is cross-cloud/region we must assume 70-120ms additional decrypt latency unless they provide a proxied local HSM. Also, HIPAA + SOC2 implies stricter trace retention controls; ask them to sign the minimal data-sharing consent for traces.

Mira (Sales): For procurement I need a price band: run-only one-off cost, and cost if they opt for a 1-week Dedicated reservation. Also note any lead times (network peering, HSM cert exchange).

Noor (Perf Eng): Cost framing: two components — infra-hours (GPU instance-hours) and run engineering/ops support. Estimating 16 A100 equiv GPUs for the main run (2h total including warm/ramp/teardown) -> 32 GPU-hours. At $3.25/GPU-hour internal rate => $104. For safety multiply by markup + ops SOW. Real world: $6k-$11k depending on observability depth, extra retention, and HSM proxy work.

Jamal (Solutions Eng): Breakout calc I used: steady tokens/sec ~ 1000 * 60 = 60k tokens/sec -> 72M tokens over 20m. If we bill token units separately that adds nominal. But customers usually accept a single run SOW fee.

Mira (Sales): Include note: if they commit to a short Dedicated trial (1 week) we can waive a portion of the run fee and apply credits. Also list SLA differences for Dedicated vs Private.

Olga (Security): Lead times: network peering + cert exchange = ~5-7 business days. KMS attestation exchange may take extra time. If they insist on Private deployment we need 2-3 weeks for deployment and security review.

infra-bot: Job queued: run_proof_1757772468_rapidsample (owner: Jamal). Tentative window: 2025-04-02T14:00Z.

Noor (Perf Eng): Monitoring checklist for the run: p50/p95/p99 (api & model), GPU util, host CPU, kernel page faults, kv_cache_hits/evictions, stream_chunk_delay, ksm/kms_unwrap_rt, downstream tool latency, 5xx rate. Alerts: p99>800ms for >90s, 5xx>0.5% sustained 2m.

Jamal (Solutions Eng): Rollback triggers: sustained p99>1.2s for 2m, GPU mem thrashing, KV eviction rate > 10%/min. Recovery play: divert traffic to short-completions pool, shrink batch sizes, drop streaming workers.

Mira (Sales): OK — Jamal/Noor, please drop the runbook + a 1-pager cost summary here by Thu EOD. I'll confirm procurement windows and KMS paperwork with the buyer.

Noor (Perf Eng): Will do. I'll also run an internal microbenchmark for FIPS KMS unwraps today and post numbers (expect 25-45ms regional with proxy, 95-180ms cross-region).

Olga (Security): I'll send the KMS questionnaire link and a short note on HIPAA/SOC2 trace redaction requirements.

Mira (Sales): Thanks team. Will sync with customer after we post the runbook. :white_check_mark:
